Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:102167: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update (Important)
Metadata.Description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: udp: Fix wildcard bind conflict check when using hash2 (CVE-2026-31503)

* kernel: crypto: ecc - Fix carry overflow in vli multiplication (CVE-2026-64313)

* kernel: net: ipip: require CAP_NET_ADMIN in the device netns for changelink (CVE-2026-72053)

* kernel: scsi: target: Bound PR-OUT TransportID parsing to the received buffer (CVE-2026-72084)

* kernel: RDMA/bnxt_re: Free SRQ toggle page after firmware teardown (CVE-2026-72500)

* kernel: RDMA/srpt: fix integer overflow in immediate data length check (CVE-2026-74394)

* kernel: RDMA/bnxt_re: Free CQ toggle page after firmware teardown (CVE-2026-72499)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: hold event_mutex while checkpointing CRIU events (CVE-2026-74446)

* kernel: nvdimm/btt: reject an arena whose nfree is below the lane count (CVE-2026-89965)

* kernel: slip: remove slip_hangup() to fix use-after-free in slip_receive_buf() (CVE-2026-90057)

* kernel: RDMA/bnxt_re: Clear VM_MAYWRITE on DBR/toggle page mmap (CVE-2026-92495)

* kernel: IB/isert: reject login PDUs declaring more data than was received (CVE-2026-90413)

* kernel: IB/isert: reject PDUs declaring more data than was received (CVE-2026-90414)

* kernel: IB/isert: delay the final Login Response until the session is registered (CVE-2026-90294)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: fix SMI event cross-process information leak (CVE-2026-97422)

* kernel: drm/amd/pm: bound pp_dpm_set_pp_table() memcpy (CVE-2026-97427)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: Check bounds for allocate_sdma_queue restore_sdma_id (CVE-2026-97497)

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: validate and share PSP fw_pri_buf copies via psp_copy_fw (CVE-2026-97494)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: Check bounds on allocate_doorbell (CVE-2026-97495)

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: Bound GPIO I2C table entry count from VBIOS (CVE-2026-97493)

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: fix buffer overflow during vBIOS update (CVE-2026-97425)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: Fix OOB memory exposure in get_wave_state() (CVE-2026-97496)

* kernel: mptcp: avoid unneeded actions on subflow reset (CVE-2026-97524)

* kernel: vxlan: mdb: Fix use-after-free in vxlan_mdb_remote_src_del() (CVE-2026-98122)

* kernel: futex: Also allocate private hash on vfork() (CVE-2026-98281)

* kernel: tcp: fix use-after-free of retransmit_skb_hint in tcp_send_synack() (CVE-2026-98374)

* kernel: tcp: prevent collapsing skbs across boundary in rtx queue (CVE-2026-98549)

* kernel: kernel: Privilege escalation via reference counter wrap in io_uring (CVE-2026-99227)

* kernel: kernel: Denial of Service via race condition in TCP socket lookup (CVE-2026-99288)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* [RHEL-9.9.z] RDMA/bnxt_re: Backport security fixes (JIRA:RHEL-301173)

* [RHEL 9] TPM becomes completely unresponsive and requires a full reboot to clear [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-260392)

* hwmon: (core) Use device name as a fallback in devm_hwmon_device_register_with_info [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-262030)

* RHEL9.8 - Backport Request: commit 09861858a68342f851f71c669ac0f69865c32151 to RHEL >=9.8 (Performance fix for virtio) [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-270723)

* [RHEL-9.9.z] RDMA/ulps: Backport security fixes (JIRA:RHEL-287039)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
